title: CS2 event guide — Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals
intro: Verified event information for the Counter-Strike 2 Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals at BLAST Arena Studios Malta: the confirmed venue, address and map pin; the free 18+ spectator reservation; the organiser's dates and phases; the published daily check-in and games agenda; match clocks in Malta time; the team field, format and prize split; the official internet streams; and the on-site practicalities that remain unanswered. Every entry states what its source does and does not establish, and schedule details can still change — re-check the organiser and ticketing pages before travelling.

records.name: BLAST Arena Studios Malta — confirmed venue, address and map pin
records.area: Ħ'Attard / Ta' Qali — MFCC National Stadium complex
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta. The ticketing page's own map links resolve to 35.8957343, 14.4168839.
records.hours: Event run Wednesday 14 – Sunday 18 October 2026; the ticketing page header lists the run as 9:30 AM–10 PM. Daily check-in and games times are in the 'Daily check-in and games times' entry.
records.price range: Entry is by event reservation — see the spectator-ticket entry. No separate venue price list was published on the pages checked.
records.description: The venue for the Counter-Strike 2 Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals is confirmed from the event's own ticketing listing: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, at the MFCC South Gate National Stadium in Attard (ATD 4000). This replaces the earlier 'venue-area context only' position, which borrowed the address from BLAST's guide for a different event: the address, the map pin and the dates now come from the listing for this event. The studio sits inside the Ta' Qali National Stadium complex — the same inland location the earlier BLAST guides pointed to, which is why the Route 186 Ta' Qali Stadium stops are the correct bus target. Use the pin (35.8957343, 14.4168839) for a taxi or journey-planner query rather than typing a town name alone; the listing does not identify an attendee gate inside the site.
records.notes: Ticketing listing (organizer Hotspawn) read directly 11 Oct 2026: https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 — its 'How do you want to get there?' links embed the destination as 35.8957343,14.4168839 and the location block reads 'BLAST Arena Studios Malta / MFCC South Gate National Stadium / ATD 4000 Attard'. Hotspawn is named as the tournament's presenting partner by Thunderpick's own 16 Sept 2026 release: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-reveals-eight-team-field-for-1-million-malta-finals-302880720.html . Independent corroboration of the same complex: BLAST's attendee guide for a separate July 2026 event ('Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre – BLAST Arena Studios … Ta Qali, ATD 4000 Ħ'Attard'): https://blast.tv/cs/news/malta-fan-guide ; the VisitMalta business-directory entry: https://www.visitmalta.co.uk/business-directory/entertainment-venues-malta/blast-arena-studios-malta ; and EventWorks: https://eventworks.mt/blast-slam-vi . What none of these establishes: the attendee gate inside the site, the walk from the Ta' Qali Stadium stops (6227 outbound / 2194 return) to that gate, or event-day traffic management. The gate and walking distance remain open questions — see docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.

This replaces the earlier planning position, which could not confirm spectator access at all. It remains dated listing evidence: it does not prove current inventory, a completed reservation by this traveller, walk-in entry, or per-day ticket validity. Re-check the listing and any ticket-holder email before travelling.

records.name: Dates, phases, format and prize pool
records.area: Malta — organiser window 12–19 October; spectator window 14–18 October
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta
records.hours: Organiser's overall programme 12–19 October 2026: Arrival Day 12 October, Media Day 13 October, Group Stage 14–16 October, Playoffs 17–18 October, Departure Day 19 October. Spectators attend the 14–18 October Finals.
records.price range: US$1,000,000 total prize pool. Organiser's published split: 1st $500,000; 2nd $250,000; 3rd $100,000; 4th $50,000; 5th–6th $30,000 each; 7th–8th $20,000 each, with every placement split 50/50 between club and players.
records.description: Two official sources agree on the competitive dates and the tournament shape. Thunderpick's own Finals page publishes the full 12–19 October programme including the non-playing arrival, media and departure days; the format (two GSL groups of four, top four into a single-elimination playoff with a third-place decider, all matches Best-of-3 except a Best-of-5 Grand Final); the $1,000,000 prize pool and its split; GAM3RS_X as tournament operator; GRID Esports as data partner; and the Schengen Area as the visa region. The event's own ticketing listing independently shows Wednesday 14 to Sunday 18 October. For this trip, every match day falls inside the 13–19 October hotel stay, and 13 October — the stay's arrival day — is the organiser's media day with no public matches.
records.notes: Organiser page read 11 Oct 2026: https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/ — it also states “Stay tuned for the latest details on match schedules, teams, and results”, which is why per-match clocks are carried in a separate record. Thunderpick-issued releases confirm the 14–18 October Finals at BLAST Studios Malta: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-returns-to-malta-with-1-million-prize-pool-302850221.html (13 Aug 2026) and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-reveals-eight-team-field-for-1-million-malta-finals-302880720.html (16 Sept 2026, datelined Ta' Qali). The ticketing listing https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 independently shows Wed 14 – Sun 18 Oct. Note the difference between the organiser's 12–19 October production window and the 14–18 October spectator/match window: no public match is scheduled on 12, 13 or 19 October.

records.name: Daily check-in and games times (official ticketing agenda)
records.area: Ħ'Attard / Ta' Qali — MFCC National Stadium complex

records.hours: As rendered on the ticketing agenda on 11 October 2026 — Wednesday 14 October: check-in 09:30, games 10:30, day listed 09:30–22:30. Thursday 15 October: check-in 09:30, games 10:30, day listed 09:30–22:30. Friday 16 October: check-in 14:00, games 15:00, day listed 14:00–21:00. Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 October sit behind a “Show all agenda” control and did not render in the text checked.
records.description: These are the times that drive event-day transport planning. Wednesday 14 and Thursday 15 October run from a 09:30 check-in to a listed 22:30 finish; Friday 16 October runs 14:00 to 21:00. Plan to arrive for check-in, not for the first game. The listed 22:30 finish on the two group-stage days is later than the last recorded bus departure from the Ta' Qali Stadium stop (20:53) and no night route was verified to reach Ta' Qali or Attard, so those two evenings cannot be done by bus alone — see the Transport guide's return-gap analysis. The listing's own header gives the run as 9:30 AM–10 PM while the Wednesday/Thursday rows extend to 22:30; the per-day rows are the more specific evidence, but confirm the finish with the organiser.
records.notes: Read directly from the ticketing listing's Agenda section on 11 Oct 2026: https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 . Three of five days rendered; Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 remain an open question. The header time (9:30 AM–10 PM) and the “4 days 12 hours” highlight do not obviously reconcile with the per-day rows, so both statements are recorded rather than averaged. The organiser's page warns that schedules can change, and the listing's FAQ includes “Can the event schedule change?” with an answer that did not render. All times are venue-local (Malta, CEST/UTC+2 until 25 October 2026). For transport planning, pair this record with `event-day-late-finish-return-gap` and `route-186-return-transfer-bugibba` in data/transport.json.

records.name: Match start times in Malta time (CEST, UTC+2) — opening day and playoffs
records.area: Ħ'Attard / Ta' Qali — MFCC National Stadium complex
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta
records.hours: Wednesday 14 October, Malta time: 10:30 9z v Aurora (Group A opener); 13:00 Falcons v Ninjas in Pyjamas (Group A opener); 15:30 Legacy v PARIVISION (Group B opener); 18:00 FURIA v BETBOOM (Group B opener). Saturday 17 October: 16:00 Semifinal 1; 19:00 Semifinal 2. Sunday 18 October: 13:30 third-place decider; 17:00 Grand Final (Best-of-5). Thursday 15 and Friday 16 October carry the remaining group-stage winners/elimination/decider matches; per-match times for those two days were not listed by any source checked.
records.description: Opening-day and playoff start times converted to Malta local time. The third-party bracket listings that carry these fixtures render clocks in the reading client's own time zone (Liquipedia showed “04:30 EDT” and its own participants panel separately prints “October 14, 2026 - 13:00 CEST” for the same Falcons–NIP match), so the conversion used here is +6 hours from US Eastern (UTC-4) to Malta CEST (UTC+2). That conversion is anchored by official evidence: the ticketing agenda states games start at 10:30 on Wednesday 14 October, exactly the converted first-match clock. Treat these clocks as planning estimates for arrival and departure, not as organiser-published guarantees — the organiser's own page still says to stay tuned for match schedules, and the ticketing FAQ flags that schedules can change.
records.notes: Per-match times recorded from Liquipedia on 11 Oct 2026: https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/Thunderpick/World_Championship/2026 — 14 Oct 04:30 / 07:00 / 09:30 / 12:00 EDT; 17 Oct 10:00 and 13:00 EDT semifinals; 18 Oct 07:30 EDT third place and 11:00 EDT Grand Final. The same page's participant panel prints “October 14, 2026 - 13:00 CEST” for Falcons–NIP, independently confirming the +6 h conversion. HLTV carries the same fixtures but renders in the viewer's time zone — the same match page has been observed at 15:30 in one view and 09:30 in another — so HLTV clocks are never copied as local time: https://www.hltv.org/matches/2399386/legacy-vs-parivision-thunderpick-world-championship-2026 , https://www.hltv.org/matches/2399387/furia-vs-betboom-thunderpick-world-championship-2026 , event page https://www.hltv.org/events/8932/thunderpick-world-championship-2026 . An earlier session correctly removed a Liquipedia-only schedule that lacked an official anchor; this record keeps the official anchor (the 10:30 games start on the ticketing agenda) in the description. Per-match times for Thursday 15 and Friday 16 October were published by no source checked and remain open.

records.name: Teams, groups, format and prize split
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta
records.price range: US$1,000,000 total prize pool: 1st $500,000; 2nd $250,000; 3rd $100,000; 4th $50,000; 5th–6th $30,000 each; 7th–8th $20,000 each, each placement split 50/50 between club and players.
records.description: Eight teams, two double-elimination (GSL) groups of four, all group matches Best-of-3; the top two from each group advance to a single-elimination playoff with a third-place decider, and the Grand Final is Best-of-5. Thunderpick's 16 September release announced the invited field as Legacy, Falcons, FURIA, BETBOOM, 9z, Aurora, PARIVISION and Virtus.pro, with FURIA the defending champions. That field has since changed: Virtus.pro withdrew on 9 October for visa and health reasons and Ninjas in Pyjamas took the slot. Opening-day groupings put Falcons, NIP, 9z and Aurora in Group A, and Legacy, PARIVISION, FURIA and BETBOOM in Group B. The ticketing listing's own “Lineup” images show Legacy, Falcons, FURIA, Betboom, 9z and Aurora before a “View all” control.
records.notes: Format, prize pool and split read from the organiser's own Finals page on 11 Oct 2026: https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/ . The eight-team field and the invite language come from https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-reveals-eight-team-field-for-1-million-malta-finals-302880720.html , which still names Virtus.pro and is therefore partly superseded. The withdrawal and replacement are reported by third-party esports media and are not yet republished on the organiser pages checked: HLTV, 9 Oct 2026 https://www.hltv.org/news/45688/thunderpick-world-championship-matchups-announced-with-virtuspro-replaced-by-nip (which also gives the opening matchups and the Group A/B split); Hotspawn https://www.hotspawn.com/counter-strike/news/nip-replace-virtus-pro-at-thunderpick-world-championship-2026 ; and Liquipedia's participant note “October 9th - Virtus.pro withdraw from the event due to health and visa issues; they are replaced by Ninjas in Pyjamas” https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/Thunderpick/World_Championship/2026 . The ticketing listing's lineup images were read on the same date: https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 . Rosters, the bracket and match order can still change — re-check before travelling.

records.name: Official streams and broadcast talent (internet, not radio)
records.area: Online — worldwide streams; no Malta radio carriage established
records.hours: All matches across the 14–18 October 2026 Finals are announced for live broadcast.
records.price range: Free-to-air online streams; no paywall was stated in the sources checked. Data costs or a hotel/venue Wi-Fi dependency apply.
records.description: The organiser states that all matches are broadcast live on Thunderpick's Twitch, Kick and YouTube channels — the fallback if a match day is missed at the venue, and the only way to watch the two days whose agenda times were not published. Announced on-air team: casters Chad “SPUNJ” Burchill, Alex “Machine” Richardson, Hugo Byron and Harry “JustHarry” Russell; desk hosts Tres “stunna” Saranthus and Sam “Tech Girl” Wright; analysts Sudhen “Bleh” Wahengbam, Janko “YNk” Paunović, Teodor “Tedd” Borisov and Jason “moses” O'Toole; sideline reporter Anastasija “Heccu” Tolmačeva; stage host James “BanKs” Banks. This is an internet stream, not a radio broadcast, and it is recorded here so the Sports-radio page is not confused by it: no Malta radio frequency carrying the event was found.
records.notes: The Thunderpick-issued 16 Sept 2026 release states “All matches will be broadcast live on Thunderpick's Twitch, Kick and YouTube” and links https://twitch.tv/thunderpicktv , https://kick.com/thunderpick and https://www.youtube.com/@thunderpickesports : https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-reveals-eight-team-field-for-1-million-malta-finals-302880720.html . The same talent list was independently reported by HLTV on 2 Oct 2026: https://www.hltv.org/news/45615/thunderpick-world-championship-talent-revealed . Stream availability, geo-blocking and platform terms were not tested from Malta. Streaming depends on connectivity — see the Everyday guide's mobile-data and Wi-Fi records.

records.name: On-site practicalities — 18+, photo ID, and nine unanswered venue questions
records.area: Ħ'Attard / Ta' Qali — MFCC National Stadium complex
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta
records.hours: Applies on each event day, 14–18 October 2026, during the published check-in and games windows.
records.price range: Not published in the page text checked — on-site food, drink and parking costs are unknown.
records.description: The ticketing listing states the event is “In person” and restricted to “ages 18+”, so every attendee must be 18 or over and carry government-issued photo ID (a US passport is the natural choice for this traveller). Beyond that, the listing poses nine FAQ questions whose answers did not render in the text checked: parking availability; the 18+ restriction; whether one ticket is valid for every day; whether tickets are scanned each day; the daily check-in and event times; whether the schedule can change; food and drink availability; toilets on site; and ticket transfer. Each has a practical consequence — parking affects the car-hire decision, per-day validity affects whether to re-register, and food/drink affects the event-day budget — so read them on the page or ask the organiser before travelling.
records.notes: The “In person” and “ages 18+” highlights and the nine FAQ question titles were read directly on 11 Oct 2026: https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 . The answers are delivered client-side and were not present in the extracted text. Do not infer an answer from another BLAST event's attendee guide — BLAST's guide for a separate July 2026 event published its own doors times and prohibited-items list, which are not transferable: https://blast.tv/cs/news/malta-fan-guide . Trip consequences are tracked in docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md; nearby pre-event food options are in the Food & cafés guide, which includes Mdina/Mosta-area entries close to the venue.
